title: Eventual regularity and asymptotic behavior of Leray-Hopf weak solutions for the Hall-MHD system
summary: In this paper, we study the incompressible, viscous and resistive Hall-magnetohydrodynamic (Hall-MHD) system. We first prove that every two-dimensional Leray-Hopf weak solution becomes smooth after a finite time. In three dimensions, where eventual smoothness for arbitrary Leray-Hopf weak solutions is not known, we construct Leray-Hopf weak solutions for which the magneto-vorticity field $B+\nabla\times u$ eventually gains additional regularity.
